GeneDef.label: vector reflex organ
GeneDef.description: A second, redundant nervous system reads the direction and speed of anything approaching and answers before the conscious mind knows it is there - momentum is not absorbed or dodged, but turned around and handed back.\n\nHeld fully open nothing lands, though the carrier cannot move, be reached or be tended, because a reflex that cannot tell a bullet from a doctor's hands reverses both. Held shut, it can still be pointed outward in short bursts.
